t: Section 116(e) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 is amended by striking out “the fiscal year 1979” and inserting in lieu thereof “the fiscal year 1980”.

fable.w: This section only makes a technical amendment that changes a fiscal year reference in the Foreign Assistance Act. It creates no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government. There is no real tempting reading, since nothing in the text mentions outside parties or any decision process.
fable.s: is amended by striking out “the fiscal year 1979” and inserting in lieu thereof “the fiscal year 1980”

opus.w: This section only replaces a fiscal-year reference in an existing statute. It does not bring anyone outside the federal government into a federal decision through comment, a hearing, an advisory body, consultation or a right to sue. Nothing in this text supports reading participation into the amended provision.
opus.s: is amended by striking out “the fiscal year 1979” and inserting in lieu thereof “the fiscal year 1980”.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a technical amendment to a fiscal year reference in the Foreign Assistance Act. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory committees, public hearings, or requirements for input from states, tribes, or the public mentioned in this text.
qwen_chat.s: Section 116(e) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 is amended by striking out “the fiscal year 1979” and inserting in lieu thereof “the fiscal year 1980”.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that amending a statute is a "decision" and that the amendment itself implies some process, but the text provided is merely a technical amendment to a fiscal year date. It contains no language regarding consultation, public comment, hearings, advisory boards with outside members, or coordination with non-federal entities. It is a simple legislative change to a deadline or funding period.
